title: Namesake Select
summary: Flags options that share a name and asks for one identifier before a shared name is picked, so the right name doesn't go to the wrong person.
description: Person picker that flags options sharing a name (ignoring case, accents and word order) with only the details that tell them apart, asks for one identifier before a shared name becomes the value, offers a switch when the answer fits the other person, and reads the choice back.
catches: Two or more people with the same name, however it is typed
The details that tell namesakes apart, shown inline
Picking a shared name: re-entry of one identifier is required (default verify="reenter")
Identifier that matches a different namesake: one-tap switch
Identical records that can't be told apart
limits: Only as good as the identifiers you pass (date of birth, city, phone)
Name matching ignores case, accents, punctuation and word order, but not nicknames or transliteration variants
Re-entry adds a step for every shared name, by design
a11y: Combobox with a visible label, aria-expanded and arrow-key/Enter navigation
Focus moves into the verification card and back to the input
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
server: Re-check the selected record ID on the server before acting on it (orders, payments, records).
stops: Right name picked for wrong person
